description: Qualified Shopify brands with a score of 18 or higher after public evidence review. Human approval is required before any outreach is sent.

leads.main_problem: The Revolution MX PDP asks mobile shoppers to evaluate a long sequence of configuration choices before purchase, but the choices are presented as dense option blocks rather than a guided configuration path.
leads.evidence: Observed on https://hi-power-cycles.myshopify.com/products/revolution-mx at 390x844 mobile and 1440x900 desktop. The PDP exposes color, battery options, charger, wheel/tire choice, component package, lighting system, and display/work stand selections before add to cart. Product price is $10,500.
leads.why_it_matters: For a high-ticket e-bike, configuration confidence is part of the purchase decision. A dense option stack may slow qualified buyers before they understand the tradeoffs behind range, charging, wheels, suspension, and lighting.
leads.potential_business_impact: Potential conversion and revenue impact through reduced configuration clarity on a high-ticket PDP.
leads.recommended_outreach_angle: Your Revolution MX PDP has a strong high-ticket offer, but the mobile configuration path may be worth simplifying before the add-to-cart decision.
leads.next_action: Wait for reply. If no reply by 2026-09-18, prepare human review before sending one follow-up.
leads.notes: Observed via public storefront only. No private contact data collected.

leads.main_problem: The Three Wheels of Magic PDP places an extremely large media gallery ahead of the product decision area on mobile, creating purchase-path friction before price, stock, and add to cart.
leads.evidence: Observed on https://falcoedrive.com/products/twm at 390x844 mobile and 1440x900 desktop. The mobile page text begins with dozens of media modal controls before the product title, price, in-stock status, and add-to-cart content. The same mobile product page also showed horizontal overflow in the browser check.
leads.why_it_matters: A $2,995 mobility product needs fast access to price, lead time, key specs, and the purchase action. Excessive media-first scrolling may delay high-intent shoppers from confirming the offer.
leads.potential_business_impact: Potential conversion and user-experience impact on a high-ticket mobility PDP.
leads.recommended_outreach_angle: Your TWM trike PDP appears to put a very large mobile media gallery before the buying details, which may be worth reviewing for purchase-path friction.
leads.contact_source: https://falcoedrive.com/pages/contact-us - Email info@falcoemotors.com and official contact form
leads.next_action: Wait for reply. If no reply by 2026-09-18, prepare human review before sending one follow-up.
leads.notes: Observed via public storefront only. No private contact data collected.

leads.main_problem: The Seafield 38L Waterproof Backpack PDP is product-rich and trust-rich, but the primary purchase state is sold out while accessories remain purchasable nearby.
leads.evidence: Observed on https://laek.co/products/seafield-38l-waterproof-backpack at 390x844 mobile and 1440x900 desktop. The product shows 4.7 reviews, $175 price, Tan 38 Liter variant, and a primary 'Sold Out' purchase state; the same PDP then presents add-to-cart accessories such as a laptop sleeve and waist belt.
leads.why_it_matters: For outdoor gear shoppers, a sold-out primary product can end the purchase path unless there is a clear restock, waitlist, alternate size, or substitution route.
leads.potential_business_impact: Potential revenue recovery opportunity from sold-out PDP handling, but commercial urgency is lower without evidence of ad traffic or active campaign volume.
leads.recommended_outreach_angle: Your Seafield backpack PDP has strong product content, but the sold-out primary purchase state may be worth turning into a clearer recovery path.
leads.next_action: Human review of draft before any manual outreach.
leads.notes: Observed via public storefront only. No private contact data collected.

leads.main_problem: The IQ Vise PDP includes a raw-looking string in the instructions area, which appears inside product-support content close to the purchase decision.
leads.evidence: Observed on https://workiqtools.com/products/iq-vise at 1440x900 desktop and 390x844 mobile. In the Instructions section, a raw string appears between repeated PDF instruction links: 'Ecmmy0dmrf000001s6exy02c7rE'.
leads.why_it_matters: For a $279.99 tool with technical setup and warranty considerations, the instructions area is part of purchase confidence. Raw or accidental content near support material can reduce trust at the point where shoppers verify usability.
leads.potential_business_impact: Potential user-experience and trust impact on a high-intent hardware PDP.
leads.recommended_outreach_angle: Your IQ Vise PDP appears to expose a raw string inside the Instructions section, which may be worth cleaning up because it sits near purchase-support content.
leads.next_action: Human review of draft before any manual outreach.
leads.notes: Observed via public storefront only. No private contact data collected.

leads.main_problem: The US localized PDP shows United States / USD while the purchase-confidence copy says free shipping across Canada, creating a market-message mismatch near add to cart.
leads.evidence: Observed on https://melabonline.com/en-us/products/mchose-ace-68-turbo-hall-effect-keyboard at 390x844 mobile and 1440x900 desktop. The page is in the /en-us path with 'United States | USD $', but the same PDP states 'Free shipping across Canada on orders $99+'.
leads.why_it_matters: For cross-border keyboard buyers, shipping clarity directly affects purchase confidence. A US buyer may not know whether the free-shipping promise applies to the selected market.
leads.potential_business_impact: Potential conversion and user-experience impact for US-market traffic on a Shopify Markets localized PDP.
leads.recommended_outreach_angle: Your US PDP appears to show Canada-specific shipping reassurance next to the add-to-cart area, which may be worth checking for Shopify Markets consistency.
